The '''Mission to Felucia''' was a mission carried out by the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], to free [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]] from a prison on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==Origins==
[[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] wanted to expose [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] as a traitor to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], by showing that he was affiliated with the Alderaanian Resistance. To facilitate this, Draco conspired with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]] to have Varth express interest in joining the Resistance, so that he could infiltrate the group. He then had Varth imprisoned on Felucia, seemingly against his will.

After helping out some Alderaanian agents on [[Sel Zonn Station]], a team of heroes traveled to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at the personal request of Bail Organa. He recruited the team to his cause and sent them on a mission to Felucia to free Varth. They traveled to the planet aboard the [[Banshee (Baudo-class)|''Banshee'']], commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sirona Okeefe]].

==The mission==
On arrival in the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]], the ''Banshee'' was attacked and shot down by a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], causing it to crash land. The damage was extensive, but not irreparable, and Okeefe and her crew set about fixing the damage, while the team set off to make their way to the Imperial prison.

The team arrived at a village of native [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]] and was attacked by them. The fight was suddenly interrupted and stopped by [[Vazus Mandrake]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who had been living with the Felucians since the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Felucians had mistook the team for Imperials, but when they learned of their true aim, they agreed to help them and show them the location of the prison. Mandrake also gave them a number of explosives and begged the team to use them to destroy the prison, because horrific experiments were being carried out on the Felucians there. They were soon interrupted by a group of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], who fled on his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]. The team pursued on several [[Kybuck/Legends|kybucks]] owned by Mandrake, and eventually defeated the Imperials.

They then made their way to the prison and were able to infiltrate it and free Varth, while confronting a many guards along the way. They also succeeded in defeating the prison's commander, [[Vischera]], along with his mutated Felucian bodyguards.

==Aftermath==
The team made their way back to the ''Banshee'', which was now operational again. Okeefe then flew it to the [[Zandrax system/Legends|Zandrax system]], where they rendezvoused with the Resistance's brand-new [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|Nebulon-B frigate]], the [[Resurgence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Resurgence'']].
